workloads.name: page_traverse_5_large
workloads.description: Open 5 large PDFs and walk every page of the page tree, touching all five page boxes and the rotation attribute. Exercises page-tree traversal and object caching on large documents.

workloads.name: text_extract_12
workloads.description: Extract text from up to 5 pages of 12 text-bearing PDFs (small and large mixed) and concatenate it. Exercises content-stream parsing, fonts and CMaps.

workloads.name: image_extract_10
workloads.description: Enumerate and extract every image of 10 image-bearing PDFs: read the raw image bytes and decode them through Pillow, recording name, byte length, pixel size and mode.

workloads.name: merge_append_5
workloads.description: Merge 5 small multi-page PDFs with PdfWriter.append in one writer and serialize the result into memory. Exercises object-graph copying and the writer.

workloads.name: rotate_crop_merge_write_5
workloads.description: Clone the pages of 5 small PDFs into a writer, rotate each page by a 90/180/270 cycle, replace the cropbox, then serialize the merged document.

workloads.name: clone_write_10
workloads.description: Clone every page of a fixed 10-PDF set (20 pages) into a fresh PdfWriter and write it. Serialization/xref baseline for a typical archive rebuild.

workloads.name: end_to_end_mixed_7
workloads.description: Full business workflow on a mixed 7-PDF set: open each file, extract text from the first pages, merge all pages with PdfWriter.append, write the result and re-open it to verify the page count.
